phone.source: tools/unreal_phone_grip_diagnostic.py PARTS (actual UE world bounds, axis aligned)

native_parity.check: Inverse(H.Rotation).RotateVector(W.Location-H.Location) and Inverse(H.Rotation)*W.Rotation from the captured log must match within 0.5 cm / 1 degree before the mount is imported

arm_ik.preserves: right-hand world rotation, all finger local rotations, bone lengths
arm_ik.note: IK moves hand and phone together, so hand-phone residuals are invariant; it only clears body skin. Hand-vs-body skin after the move and forearm skin re-deformation are not re-skinned here; root re-audits natively.

candidates.label: pinch-4s

right_hand_correction.apply: RightHand local rotation := captured local * correction (every frame); all finger locals, bone lengths and other bones unchanged; phone mount is expressed in the corrected RightHand frame

candidates.provenance: fit_phone_grip seeds(kinds=pinch) + 9-DOF CEM (40 it, 48 pop) on the exact 4.000 s frame; best of 8 starts
candidates.role: frozen 4 s review (the only native review pose today): contact-true pinch

candidates.label: fullclip-clean

right_hand_correction.apply: RightHand local rotation := captured local * correction (every frame); all finger locals, bone lengths and other bones unchanged; phone mount is expressed in the corrected RightHand frame

candidates.provenance: fit_phone_grip --wrist-correction --seed-set pinch, rank1 after CEM on 4 s then every 25th frame
candidates.role: full-clip playback: cleanest across all frames, weaker support

captured_thumb_middle_gap.note: min skin distance Thumb3 pad to Middle3 pad per frame; a rigid 1.5 cm pinch needs >=1.5

comparison_current_root_mount.source: root report, current rigid mount at its review pose
